key_idea: Dan must share exactly one shape with Amy, one with Ben and one with Cleo.
steps: Amy and Ben both have a square. Amy and Cleo both have a star. Ben and Cleo both have a heart.
If Dan had a square, a star or a heart, he would share 2 shapes with someone. So he has none of those.
He takes the circle from Amy, the triangle from Ben and the diamond from Cleo.
Circle, triangle, diamond is picture E.
